thread:
emma (Finance): FYI CatalystHealth flagged INV-11789 — burst line $4,500 on Dedicated true-up. They claim platform failover caused a spike and want full credit. Can AcctOps confirm metering?
raj (AcctOps): pulling the metering now. link: https://s3.redwood-internal/usage/catalysthealth/2026-12.csv
billing-bot: Meter summary: reserved_commit=200,000 tokens, billed_usage=222,500 tokens, burst=22,500 tokens, burst_charge=$4,500. Outage detected region-us-east-1 2026-12-12T18:05:00 - 2026-12-12T18:20:00 UTC.
taylor (Customer Success): CatalystHealth reports they retried many requests during that 15m window because their retry policy was aggressive. They want either full waiver or a combined SLA credit + waiver.
mo (Sales): We told them during onboarding we'd evaluate credits for platform incidents. Need a finance-approved number to offer quickly.
emma (Finance): Can AcctOps provide a breakdown: total tokens in window + tokens marked as automatic retry/duplicate? Raj, SQL would be fine: `SELECT sum(tokens) FROM token_events WHERE customer='catalysthealth' AND ts BETWEEN '2026-12-12T18:00Z' AND '2026-12-12T19:00Z';`
raj (AcctOps): Ran it: total_tokens=22,850 in that hour slice. Retried/duplicate tokens flagged=6,000. I attached CSV excerpt for 18:05-18:20 in the ticket.
emma (Finance): Token unit price on that contract for burst = $0.20/token. So retried 6k -> $1,200. Burst charge line $4,500 total. Contract SLA clause: outage credit = 15% of monthly committed fee = $2,700.
olga (Finance Manager): Proposed customer remediation: waive retried charges ($1,200) AND apply SLA credit ($2,700) = total credit $3,900. That leaves $600 of burst charge retained. From accounting POV we should record ADJ-2026-12-CAT and update INV-11789. Any objections?
mo (Sales): Sounds reasonable. Keeps some revenue but shows customer we took action. I'll pre-approve this externally for the CS message.
taylor (Customer Success): I'll send the customer the combined offer: retry waiver + SLA credit = $3,900. Promise corrected invoice within 24h.
raj (AcctOps): On our side we'll post a negative line item on INV-11789 for $3,900 and create journal entry JE-2026-12-CAT. Once done I'll drop the adjusted PDF link here.
billing-bot: Adjustment queued: INV-11789 credit $3,900 pending approval by olga (Finance Manager).
olga (Finance Manager): Approved. Raj, please proceed and include memo: "Retry waiver + SLA credit for outage us-east-1 2026-12-12".
raj (AcctOps): Posted adjustment and journal entry. Adjusted invoice: https://billing.redwood/INVOICES/INV-11789/adjusted.pdf JE: JE-2026-12-CAT
billing-bot: INV-11789 updated: credit $3,900 applied. PDF available: https://billing.redwood/INVOICES/INV-11789/adjusted.pdf
taylor (Customer Success): CatalystHealth replied: "Appreciate it — we'll accept the credit. Please confirm no further action needed." Closing thread.
emma (Finance): Quick follow-up item: ask platform to tag retry-attribution at ingestion so these are easier to reconcile in future true-ups. I'll file ticket with eng-platform.
mo (Sales): I'll flag CatalystHealth as "watchlist" for 60 days in CRM.
olga (Finance Manager): Noted for audit. GL comment added to JE-2026-12-CAT.
raj (AcctOps): Closing this thread."
